id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

iconSuffix.description: An icon to appear on the left side of the title.

editableTitle.description: Whether or not to make the title editable. Adds icon to the right of the title.

color.description: Color of the bar in any valid CSS format

actions.description: Actions to appear on the right side of the top bar.

actionsVisibilityMap.description:
Map to show/hide action on the right side of the top bar.
This config will be used as a reference to whether show or hide the actions of the top bar.
If no `actionsVisibilityMap` is provided, all `actions` will be shown by default.
If an action is not provided to the map and it exists in the `actions` array,
that action will be shown by default.

Have the following configuration as an example:
```
"actions": [
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.IconArrow" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.LoadingPrimaryOutlineMedium" }
],
"actionsVisibilityMap": {
 "SDLDemo.IconArrow": true,
 "SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge": false
}
```
The `SDLDemo.IconArrow` and `SDLDemo.LoadingPrimaryOutlineMedium` actions will be shown,
while the `SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge` action will be hidden.

inputs.description: Input group to appear on the left side of the top bar. Maximum 8 inputs.

inputsVisibilityMap.description:
Map to show/hide inputs of the top bar.
This config will be used as a reference to whether show or hide the inputs of the top bar.
If no `inputsVisibilityMap` is provided, all `inputs` will be shown by default.
If an input is not provided to the map and it exists in the `inputs` array,
that input will be shown by default.

Have the following configuration as an example:
```
"inputs": [
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TextFieldLg" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TopBarSegmentedButton" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TopBarTextInput" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TopBarSegmentedButton" }
],
"inputsVisibilityMap": {
  "SDLDemo.TopBarTextInput": false,
  "SDLDemo.TextFieldLg": true
}
```
The `SDLDemo.TextFieldLg` and `SDLDemo.TopBarSegmentedButton` inputs will be shown,
while the `SDLDemo.TopBarTextInput` input will be hidden.
